description: Creates an A/B notification on the current site with two variants (variant_a and variant_b). Required: variant_a (title, message, url) and variant_b (title, message, url). By default (intelligent_ab_test omitted) both variants ship as-is to the audience — no automatic winner picking. Pass intelligent_ab_test to enable intelligent / auto-winner mode: each variant is sent to sent_limit_percentage% of subscribers, and after winner_delay_minutes the higher-CTR variant is automatically delivered to the remaining audience (up to sent_limit total). Only include intelligent_ab_test when the user explicitly asks for an intelligent / auto-winner test. Do not add other optional fields (tags, audience_groups, per-variant image_url, utm_params, actions, etc.) unless the user explicitly asks. Audience: by default sends to all subscribers. Pass `audience_groups` (1-20 predefined audience-group IDs) only when the user mentions a saved/predefined audience group. Use status="schedule" with schedule_date to schedule for later, or status="draft" to save without sending.

audience_groups.description: Send to one or more predefined audience groups (1-20 group IDs). Applies to both variants. Omit to send to all subscribers. Only set when the user mentions a saved/predefined audience group.

intelligent_ab_test.description: OPTIONAL. Enables intelligent A/B testing: each variant is delivered to sent_limit_percentage% of subscribers, then after winner_delay_minutes the variant with the higher click-through rate is automatically sent to the remaining audience (up to sent_limit subscribers total). Omit this field to send a plain A/B where both variants ship as-is to the audience with no automatic winner selection. Only include when the user explicitly asks for an intelligent / auto-winner A/B test.

result_name.description: Optional human-readable label for the A/B test result row.

sent_limit.description: Total subscriber cap across the test and the winner roll-out. e.g. 10000 means up to 10000 subscribers will be touched in total.

sent_limit_percentage.description: Percentage of sent_limit allocated to each variant for the test phase. e.g. 10 means 10% to A, 10% to B, and the remaining 80% goes to the winner after winner_delay_minutes.

winner_delay_minutes.description: How long to wait (in minutes, max 10080 = 7 days) before picking the winner (higher CTR) and rolling out to the remaining audience.

schedule_date.description: Required when status is "schedule". Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss in the site timezone.

status.description: Send now (sent), schedule for later (schedule), or save without sending (draft). The API only accepts sent and scheduled in the body; draft is conveyed via the action query param while the body still carries status="sent".

tags.description: Up to 5 tags, 36 chars each. Only when the user explicitly asks for tags.

big_image_url.description: Large hero image for this variant. Only when the user explicitly asks.

image_url.description: Small icon for this variant. Only when the user explicitly asks.

url.description: Destination URL when the subscriber clicks the variant

utm_params.description: UTM tracking params for this variant.

name: pushengage_send_ab_notification
title: Send an A/B push notification
